newsitem.title: USA: Unigene in $50 mln Warner-Lambert deal.
newsitem.headline: Unigene in $50 mln Warner-Lambert deal.

text.p: Unigene Laboratories Inc said on Monday it signed a letter of intent with Warner-Lambert Co's Parke-Davis division to co-develop an oral calcitonin product for the treatment of osteoporosis.

Unigene said in a news release that it would receive $50 million in up-front and milestone payments from the licensing agreement, and Warner-Lambert would buy an undisclosed amount of Unigene stock. Under the terms of the proposed deal, Warner-Lambert would develop and market the product, while Unigene would provide analytical support and would be the exclusive supplier of the raw material.
Calcitonin currently is only available in injectable and nasal forms.
